briefing: - PHP两个UAF已入KEV并遭在野利用，EPSS近满分，优先修复。
- 今日批量公告密集：多个9.9-10.0分注入与内存破坏漏洞集中披露。
- 清单未见勒索软件关联，但仍需排查暴露面与异常加密行为。
- 最急处置：先升PHP至8.2.35/8.3.36以上，再修Pillow堆溢出。
- Pillow堆溢出9.8且有PoC，图像服务应紧急升级至13.0.0。

items.title: PHP全局状态UAF可致远程代码执行
items.title_zh: PHP全局状态UAF可致远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过构造请求输入，使临时指向请求内存的全局状态被提前释放，已在野利用，可导致内存破坏乃至代码执行
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级到 8.2.35 或 8.3.36 及以上版本，并排查历史请求日志中的异常利用痕迹
items.repro_note: 无；需构造请求使全局状态残留指向已释放请求内存，依赖特定扩展组合
items.impact_scope: Web运行环境核心组件，影响面极广
items.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: PHP内存耗尽长跳转UAF致RCE
items.title_zh: PHP内存耗尽长跳转UAF致RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者构造内存耗尽场景触发longjmp跳出上下文，遗留全局状态指向已释放内存，已在野利用并可能执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级到 8.2.35 或 8.3.36 及以上版本，收紧请求内存上限并监控OOM异常
items.repro_note: 触发OOM使longjmp中止请求处理，随后访问残留全局状态；可审计源码构造PoC
items.impact_scope: PHP-FPM/Apache模块，互联网暴露面广
items.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

items.title: Pillow TIFF处理堆溢出可越界读写
items.title_zh: Pillow TIFF处理堆溢出可越界读写
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意TIFF标签或ICC数据，诱导应用解析时写出分配边界并泄露堆内存，可致内存破坏甚至代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级 Pillow 至 13.0.0 及以上版本，解析前限制图像尺寸与标签长度
items.repro_note: 解析含超长离行TIFF标签或保留ICC的图片；入口需接收不可信图像文件
items.impact_scope: 图像处理依赖库，广泛嵌入Web服务
items.description: The callback sizes its allocation from the prior buffer size instead of the current write position, allowing an attacker-controlled out-of-line TIFF tag or retained ICC profile to be copied beyond the allocation after libtiff seeks forward. Independently, unwritten alignment gaps in compressed TIFF output larger than 64 KiB can disclose stale heap bytes without a crafted tag.

items.title: TTLock硬编码AES密钥可解BLE会话
items.title_zh: TTLock硬编码AES密钥可解BLE会话
items.summary_zh: 蓝牙范围内的攻击者利用App与固件中硬编码的AES密钥，解密BLE配对时传输的会话密钥，进而开锁或重放指令
items.action_zh: 升级App至 9.8.260718 及以上并同步升级门锁固件，改用动态协商密钥
items.repro_note: 近场抓取BLE配对报文后以硬编码密钥解出会话密钥；需实体锁与App配合
items.impact_scope: 智能门锁，近场蓝牙攻击面
items.description: TTLock Android application before v9.8.260718 and associated smart-lock firmware contain a hardcoded static AES key vulnerability that allows an attacker within Bluetooth range to decrypt the per-pairing session key transmitted during BLE pairing.

items.title: Asterisk PJSIP释放后重用漏洞
items.title_zh: Asterisk PJSIP释放后重用漏洞
items.summary_zh: 已认证SIP用户通过面向连接的传输发送INVITE后立即断开，在200 OK返回前触发堆释放后重用，可致服务崩溃
items.repro_note: 已认证账号经TCP/TLS发送INVITE并抢在200 OK前断开，触发SDP处理UAF
items.impact_scope: 企业IPPBX/呼叫中心，常暴露SIP端口
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, an authenticated attacker may cause a heap-use-after-free in `PJSIP TCP/SDP` handling by sending a `SIP INVITE` over a connection-oriented transport and disconnecting before Asterisk responds with the `200 OK`.

items.title: 苹果CMS找回密码校验缺失致账号接管
items.title_zh: 苹果CMS找回密码校验缺失致账号接管
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者用自己邮箱通过findpass_msg获取验证码，再以受害者邮箱或手机提交findpass_reset，即可重置任意会员密码
items.action_zh: 升级至 2026.1000.4054 及以上，或临时关闭找回密码相关接口
items.repro_note: 未授权访问 user/findpass_msg 取自己的验证码，再用 victim 邮箱调 findpass_reset
items.impact_scope: 中小型视频/内容站点CMS，公网可达
items.description: MacCMS v10 before 2026.1000.4054 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset any member's password because check_msg() never compares msg_to. Attackers can request a recovery code to their own mailbox via user/findpass_msg, then submit it to user/findpass_reset with the victim's email or phone to take over the account.

items.title: OpenHands沙箱默认无认证RCE
items.title_zh: OpenHands沙箱默认无认证RCE
items.summary_zh: DockerWorkspace/Apptainer启动器把沙箱agent绑定0.0.0.0且会话密钥为空，网络可达者未授权下发任务执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级至 1.52.0 及以上，配置session_api_keys并限定监听地址
items.repro_note: 默认启动沙箱后直接访问agent HTTP接口下发执行指令；需0.0.0.0可达
items.impact_scope: AI Agent沙箱服务，容器环境易横向
items.description: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability where the DockerWorkspace and Apptainer workspace launchers bind the sandbox agent server to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) with an empty session_api_keys list, disabling authentication by default.

items.title: MCP Toolbox路径遍历致任意文件读写
items.title_zh: MCP Toolbox路径遍历致任意文件读写
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者构造工具调用参数遍历路径，可将主机文件外传至外部GCS桶或覆盖本地任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 暂无明确修复版本，建议禁用cloud-storage源并限制Toolbox外部访问
items.repro_note: 向cloud-storage源工具调用参数注入../，未授权即可读取主机文件
items.impact_scope: 数据库MCP服务，多部署于内网
items.description: Path Traversal and Missing Authorization in cloud-storage source in Google Cloud MCP Toolbox for Databases (googleapis/mcp-toolbox) versions 1.2.0 through 1.4.0 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exfiltrate host files to external Google Cloud Storage buckets and overwrite arbitrary local files via crafted tool invocation parameters.

items.title: ERP系统栈溢出漏洞可远程执行代码
items.title_zh: ERP系统栈溢出漏洞可远程执行代码
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向对外ERP服务提交畸形超长数据触发栈溢出，可能导致业务进程崩溃甚至执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 厂商未公布修复版本，先收敛ERP服务暴露面并加强边界输入校验
items.repro_note: 入口为对外ERP服务解析逻辑，需构造超长字段；具体组件与参数未标注
items.impact_scope: 企业ERP对外服务，内网核心业务系统
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this issue is the function sub_402340 of the file infostat.cgi of the component Device-Information CGI. Performing a manipulation of the argument CONTENT_LENGTH results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: 未知组件regmsg参数CRLF注入
items.title_zh: 未知组件regmsg参数CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向regmsg参数注入CRLF字符，可拆分响应报文或伪造头部，用于缓存投毒、会话劫持与日志伪造
items.action_zh: 对regmsg参数做CR/LF过滤并输出编码；暂无官方修复信息
items.repro_note: 向regmsg参数注入%0d%0a观察响应头分裂；具体产品未标注，需先定位资产
items.impact_scope: 产品未定位，需确认资产是否受影响
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the component Ser2net. Performing a manipulation of the argument regmsg results in crlf injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: info.community参数CRLF注入
items.title_zh: info.community参数CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向info.community参数注入CRLF，可伪造响应头或拆分报文，造成缓存投毒与凭据泄露
items.action_zh: 对community参数做CR/LF过滤与输出编码；暂无官方修复信息
items.repro_note: 向info.community注入%0d%0a观察头部拆分；产品未标注，需先定位受影响组件
items.impact_scope: 产品未定位，需先排查资产
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. This affects the function snmp_set of the component SNMP Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument info.community can lead to crlf injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG云升级命令注入
items.title_zh: TOTOLINK A950RG云升级命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可远程调用云升级流程，在FileName参数拼接系统命令，在路由器上以高权限执行任意指令
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，建议禁用云升级功能并限制管理界面仅内网访问
items.repro_note: 向 setCloudUpgradeFW 的 FileName 传入命令分隔符触发拼接，需可访问升级接口
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器，公网管理面易被扫描
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This affects the function setCloudUpgradeFW of the file lib/cste_modules/upgrade.so of the component Cloud Upgrade. The manipulation of the argument FileName leads to command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG防火墙命令注入
items.title_zh: TOTOLINK A950RG防火墙命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者通过防火墙相关管理接口操纵apmib_set参数注入系统命令，可在路由器上以高权限执行指令
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，建议关闭远程管理、限制管理面访问并等待厂商固件
items.repro_note: 经防火墙配置接口向apmib_set传入恶意值触发命令拼接，需具备管理入口
items.impact_scope: SOHO路由器，常作为内网出口设备
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected is the function apmib_set of the file firewall.so. This manipulation causes command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: danmu_api默认令牌致未授权配置篡改
items.title_zh: danmu_api默认令牌致未授权配置篡改
items.summary_zh: 使用默认TOKEN且未设ADMIN_TOKEN时，未授权者可调用/api/env/set等接口写入ADMIN_TOKEN、篡改代理配置并接管服务
items.action_zh: 升级至 1.21.7 及以上，修改默认TOKEN并显式设置ADMIN_TOKEN
items.repro_note: 默认配置下直接POST /api/env/set写入ADMIN_TOKEN；前置为未改默认TOKEN
items.impact_scope: 自建弹幕服务，常直接暴露公网
items.description: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment configuration when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/env/set, /api/env/add, or /api/env/del to set ADMIN_TOKEN, lock out operators, redirect OTHER_SERVER or PROXY_URL for SSRF, and trigger redeployment.

items.title: WolfProt接口命令注入致未授权RCE
items.title_zh: WolfProt接口命令注入致未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备网络访问的未授权攻击者向WolfProt接口提交恶意输入，即可以应用服务权限执行操作系统命令
items.action_zh: 关注厂商补丁；暂无修复版本，先限制该服务网络访问并加前置鉴权
items.repro_note: 未授权访问WolfProt接口，向拼接命令的字段注入载荷；需网络可达
items.impact_scope: 对外服务接口，网络可达即可利用
items.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the WolfProt interface implementation. Insufficient neutralization of user-controlled input could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to a vulnerable service to execute operating-system commands with the privileges of the affected application service.

items.title: vSolution Matrix密钥共享提权
items.title_zh: vSolution Matrix密钥共享提权
items.summary_zh: 仅当设备为主站且启用文件共享时，取得匹配私钥者可冒充受信主机，以root身份SSH登录受影响设备
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，先禁用文件共享功能并轮换共享密钥对
items.repro_note: 需先获取共享私钥，再以受信主机身份SSH登录主站；前置为开启文件共享
items.impact_scope: 会议室协作设备主站，典型内网部署
items.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the vSolution Matrix file sharing feature. A shared cryptographic trust configuration could allow an attacker who obtains the matching private key to authenticate to an affected device via SSH as root. This vulnerability affects only devices configured as a vSolution Matrix main/master station with the file sharing feature enabled.

items.title: wsserver终端桥命令注入RCE
items.title_zh: wsserver终端桥命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者通过WebSocket公钥会话路径提交恶意字段，被拼入system/popen调用，以root权限执行命令
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复；限制wsserver端口暴露并补充会话校验与参数转义
items.repro_note: 经公钥会话路径向拼接字段注入命令，无需应用会话；需WebSocket端口可达
items.impact_scope: 终端桥接守护进程，root权限危害大
items.description: The root-privileged `wsserver` terminal-bridge daemon builds a shell command from client-supplied WebSocket fields and passes it to `system()` and `popen()` without quoting, escaping, or character-set validation. The daemon's public-key session path performs no appliance-session check.

items.title: ArcGIS Server SQL注入
items.title_zh: ArcGIS Server SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 拥有服务访问权的远程攻击者（服务配置为public时含匿名用户）注入SQL，调用不应开放的函数读写数据库
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，并将服务访问权限收紧为非匿名
items.repro_note: 对配置为公开的地图/要素服务参数注入SQL；需服务允许匿名访问
items.impact_scope: 企业GIS门户，常发布至公网
items.description: There is a SQL injection vulnerability in Esri ArcGIS Server versions 12.1 and earlier on Windows and Linux that may allow a remote attacker with privileges to access the service (which could, depending on the service being configured in a non-default access configuration “public”, include an anonymous attacker) to issue database specific functions that should not be allowed.

items.title: 未知平台凭据校验不足致管理员冒充
items.title_zh: 未知平台凭据校验不足致管理员冒充
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用凭据保护缺陷枚举平台用户并伪造任意用户（含管理员）会话，读写敏感数据、篡改配置
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，先限制平台访问并加强凭据与会话校验
items.repro_note: 针对会话/凭据校验接口伪造身份；具体产品与入口未标注，需先确认资产
items.impact_scope: 统一管理平台，管理员权限集中
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by manipulating authentication requests and accessing APIs without a valid authenticated session on the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to enumerate platform users, establish sessions as arbitrary users including administrative users, access and modify sensitive information with the privileges of the impersonated user.

items.title: 蒲公英X5 Pro L2TP认证CRLF注入
items.title_zh: 蒲公英X5 Pro L2TP认证CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向L2TP认证的Username参数注入CRLF，可污染认证与会话处理流程。
items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；限制L2TP/VPN入口访问并监控异常配置。
items.repro_note: 向L2TP认证Username字段注入CRLF，需可访问VPN/L2TP入口。
items.impact_scope: 蒲公英SD-WAN/VPN网关，常暴露公网
items.description: A flaw has been found in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the component L2TP Authentication. This manipulation of the argument Username causes crlf injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 蒲公英X5 Pro 租期参数CRLF注入
items.title_zh: 蒲公英X5 Pro 租期参数CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向Dnsmasq的rent_time参数注入CRLF，可篡改DHCP租期相关配置。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，关闭公网Dnsmasq/DHCP管理入口并审计租期配置。
items.repro_note: 在DHCP租期请求rent_time参数中注入CRLF，需可访问管理面。
items.impact_scope: 蒲公英网关Dnsmasq组件，内网出口设备
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. This impacts an unknown function of the component Dnsmasq. The manipulation of the argument rent_time leads to crlf injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 蒲公英X5 Pro IPsec CRLF注入
items.title_zh: 蒲公英X5 Pro IPsec CRLF注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向IPsec策略的secproto参数注入CRLF，可污染ipsec.conf配置内容。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，限制IPsec配置接口访问并核查ipsec.conf完整性。
items.repro_note: 在IPsec策略secproto参数注入CRLF写入/etc/ipsec.conf，需管理权限或接口可达。
items.impact_scope: 蒲公英网关IPsec模块，站点互联边界
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Oray Pugongying X5 Pro 7.6.1. Affected is an unknown function of the file /etc/ipsec.conf of the component IPsec Policy Handler. The manipulation of the argument secproto results in crlf injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: hackney证书校验缺陷可绕过固定CA
items.title_zh: hackney证书校验缺陷可绕过固定CA
items.summary_zh: 中间人可用公网可信证书链通过私有CA固定校验，冒充被固定主机。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级hackney至修复版本，或在应用层自行校验证书链固定。
items.repro_note: 需中间人位置及被固定主机名的公网可信证书，构造替代链。
items.impact_scope: Erlang/Elixir HTTP客户端库，MITM场景
items.description: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in hackney_ssl in benoitc hackney allows an on-path attacker to impersonate a server pinned to a private certificate authority via a certificate chain that ends in a publicly trusted root. The hostname check still applies, so the attacker needs a publicly trusted certificate for the pinned hostname.

items.title: TOTOLINK A950RG 命令注入
items.title_zh: TOTOLINK A950RG 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者经DHCP租约写入恶意MAC，触发getDeviceInfo命令注入执行。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，限制LAN接入并关闭远程管理功能。
items.repro_note: 先向LAN发DHCP请求写入恶意MAC至udhcpd.leases，再调用getDeviceInfo。
items.impact_scope: 家用/SOHO路由器，多部署于网络边界
items.description: A vulnerability was found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. This impacts the function getDeviceInfo of the file /var/lib/misc/udhcpd.leases of the component device-information Handler. The manipulation of the argument MAC address results in command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: boneIO服务账号过度授权致本地提权
items.title_zh: boneIO服务账号过度授权致本地提权
items.summary_zh: 本地攻击者先拿下boneio账号，再借无密码sudo权限与docker组成员身份提权至root并控制设备
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复镜像，移除boneio的免密sudo并移出docker组
items.impact_scope: 嵌入式设备本地权限，需先失陷账号
items.description: boneIO black_debian_images gives the boneio service account excessive privileges, including full passwordless sudo access and membership in the docker group. A local attacker who compromises the boneio user can use these privileges to escalate to root.
